run_document_qa_pipeline: run the DocumentQuestionAnsweringPipeline to answer questions from document images using LayoutLM or Donut models
apply_tesseract_ocr: apply Tesseract OCR to a document image and return recognized words with normalized bounding boxes
decode_answer_spans: decode model start and end probabilities into the k-best answer spans with scores
select_starts_ends_qa: select answer start and end positions from model logits using p-mask filtering and probability normalization
normalize_bounding_boxes: normalize document bounding box coordinates to a 0-1000 scale relative to image dimensions
